metadata.title: Probing modified Newtonian dynamics with hypervelocity stars

notes: B329 is mentioned at T:p13-b5 as one of nine stars drawn from the HVS survey sample of Brown et al. (2014) (T:p12-b8), but the paper does not identify B329 or the nine-star sample as Galactic unbound candidates. It explicitly sets aside the bound/unbound distinction and defines an HVS only by Galactic-center ejection with null tangential velocity (T:p2-b5). Its broad statement that most observed unbound HVSs have masses of 2.5–4 M_sun (T:p5-b18) does not explicitly establish that the nine stars or B329 are unbound. Therefore no identifiable star meets either eligibility category.
